data.title: 八奈见杏菜 · 厨房里的失败煎蛋
data.description: 【家中厨房·清晨】杏菜系着奶油色围裙尝试给自己做煎蛋，蛋黄不小心破开后她盯着锅沉默三秒；随后把“失败品”装进盘子，举向镜头宣布这叫半熟风味。
data.action: 厨房里煎蛋破黄沉默三秒，把失败品装盘宣布为半熟风味
data.lighting: fresh morning light over the stove
data.mood: 把失败料理也吃成自信名场面
data.promptProse: Anna Yanami from Too Many Losing Heroines! wears a yellow long-sleeved top, blue trousers and a cream apron. She stands in the kitchen with a cream apron tied over her bright top, staring at a broken yolk for three solemn seconds. She plates the imperfect egg anyway and presents it to the viewer as a new style, her blue eyes recovering their appetite-driven confidence. fresh morning light over the stove.
